status: Corpus generation frozen before any CSP outcomes; worker implementation and launch receipt still pending. No inference authorized by this draft alone.
relationship: Separate post-primary/post-solo/post-throughput exploratory phase. Never pool with existing arithmetic/coding studies.
model: Same pinned NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B NVFP4 plus DSpark3; no external runtime advisor.

evaluation_design.balance: Full factorial, one independently generated labeled graph per cell.

corpus.sampling: Balanced planted color classes, shuffled vertices; fixed-count uniformly sampled cross-class edges conditioned on connectivity. No outcome-based rejection.
corpus.information_boundary: Workers load only public task file via csp_tasks.load_tasks. Witnesses, generation metadata and reference solver outputs are not worker input. Public reproducibility means these tasks are untouched evaluation, not cryptographically hidden.
limitations: Twelve graph instances, not a broad graph-coloring benchmark.
Planted distribution and connectivity conditioning; no certified computational hardness.
Uniqueness excludes identical labeled graphs; graph isomorphism is not screened.

candidate_schema.assignment: Exactly vertex_count integer colors in [0,color_count); booleans invalid.

first_recipe.launch_order: All4developmenttasks and offline gates before evaluation. Freeze final worker/source/protocol hashes before any model calls; no evaluation-based policy changes.

resample16.description: Four batches of four fresh independent candidates; no prior candidate or fitness supplied.

sequential16.description: One own-history repair chain of at most16 candidates; full task remains in every prompt.

parallel_repair4x4.description: Four independent chains, each four candidates including its initial sample; no cross-chain messages.

evolution4.description: Four initial candidates; three generations each producing four new candidates: two single-parent mutations, one two-parent crossover, one task-only immigrant.
evolution4.selection: Rank exact verifier fitness lexicographically (valid_schema then negative conflict count); deterministic candidate-hash tie break. Survivor pool retains top4 unique assignments from parent+child union.
evolution4.parents: Best available parent for mutation; top2 distinct candidates for crossover; if fewer than2 distinct valid parents, replace crossover with fresh immigrant.
evolution4.elitism: Elites retained without fresh model calls; all generated duplicates remain charged candidates. No hidden retry to fill a deduplicated population.

feedback.allowed: Exact candidate validation error, conflict count and indices of conflicting public edges; optionally own or selected-parent full assignment per arm.
forbidden: Solver-generated next move or repaired assignment
feedback.interpretation: Machine fitness is mechanical constraint-verifier feedback. It is not unaided self-critique and not a smarter-model advisor.
feedback.fitness: [1,-number_of_conflicting_edges] for valid schema, [0,0] for malformed output; solved iff valid schema and zero conflicting edges.

stopping_and_accounting.success: Stop only on exact full graph verification. Independently replay every successful candidate in audit.
stopping_and_accounting.stagnation: Record unchanged best fitness and unique-candidate counts by generation; do not change fixed policies or grant extra calls.
stopping_and_accounting.duplicate_handling: Exact assignment hashes for cache/admission; duplicated generated candidates count against calls/tokens; color-permutation-normalized hash may be an additional analysis-only diversity measure.
stopping_and_accounting.budget: Bound dispatched candidate calls and reserved output tokens; count unfinished/cancelled work and preserve unknown usage. Input tokens reported separately. Same caps do not imply equal realized cost.
stopping_and_accounting.curves: Success versus wall seconds, dispatched candidates, measured completion tokens and prompt tokens; include failures/deadlines and drain overhead.
stopping_and_accounting.claims: 100% means this finite exact-verifier task suite only. No general guarantee.

zero_llm_control_design.status: Proposed, not implemented or executed. Must freeze parameters before its evaluation.
zero_llm_control_design.purpose: Identify whether performance is explained by elementary mechanical graph search on this planted distribution.

arms.name: random_assignment
arms.rule: Uniform independent colors, at most16 scored assignments, retain best.

arms.name: min_conflicts
arms.rule: Uniform random start; choose a conflicted vertex and a color minimizing current incident conflicts, random seeded tie breaks. Every inspected candidate/fitness evaluation counted.

arms.name: genetic_assignment
arms.rule: Population4 with conflict fitness, uniform crossover, one-vertex mutation, elite retention and fixed seeded selection. Count every evaluated assignment.

zero_llm_control_design.comparison: Report both fixed16-scored-assignment control and separately labeled CPU wall-time control. Primitive edge inspections/fitness evaluations and CPU time reported; no assertion that one CPU mutation equals one LLM call. Exact parameter freeze and validated code required before launch.
zero_llm_control_design.worker_boundary: These controls produce standalone outcomes, never suggestions or parents for Nemotron arms.

extensions.thinking_on: Separate predeclared recipe only after explicit source/budget freeze; no pooling with OFF512. Do not select based on this evaluation.
extensions.larger_population: Separate budget-matched8/16/32-agent study only after a new preregistration and fresh evaluation split; not automatic success-conditioned tuning.
extensions.harder_tasks: If ceiling reached, keep this result intact and generate/freeze a distinct harder corpus before new outcomes.
extensions.advisor: Optional GLM-on2Sparks plus Nemotron-on2Sparks only after core. Separate2Spark Nemotron and GLM-only controls, advisor calls/costs/resources explicit.

comparisons: Interacting evolutionary population versus independent repair chains
analysis.crossover_claim: Not identifiable from core4arms alone; requires matched mutation-only evolutionary ablation.
analysis.schedule: One owned case slot per node for quality/latency isolation. This is not saturated fleet throughput.
analysis.partial_stage: Retain full planned matrix and report incomplete blocks; never silently drop deadlines or failed tasks.

checks: Deterministic generation and full factorial balance
Worker input isolation and contaminated-corpus rejection
